summaries.V1-map-panels-1-3: Verified 39 discrete claims across the workspaces, ads-commerce, and film-video panels: 34 confirmed, 1 corrected, 1 stale, 3 unverifiable, 0 refuted. The one real error: Google Asset Studio's "~70M Gemini-generated assets in Q4 2025 PMax alone" — Google's Feb 11, 2026 blog says the ~70M figure spans AI Max AND Performance Max ("alone" modifies Q4, not PMax), so drop "alone" or add AI Max. Runway's "last reported ~$90M mid-2025" is stale — estimate trackers put annualized revenue at ~$300M by Oct 2025, consistent with the note's own $100-300M range but making "$90M last reported" misleading. Three sub-claims could not be corroborated despite multiple searches: Canva's "third-party shelf," Figma Weave's "shareable AI workflows in Figma Community," and Meta's "Advantage+ rollout still pending as of mid-Aug" (last evidence Jul 8: rollout "coming weeks"; no completion coverage found, so pendency is plausible but unproven).
summaries.consistency: Checked data.ts + page.tsx against all six research files. Citation integrity is clean: all 27 page Cite ids and 15 facts.cite ids resolve to SOURCES (1 confirmed). Found 7 corrected items — the biggest are Meshy's ARR ($40M in the report vs $30M in the research quoting the same source, which also breaks the '~35x' multiple), Kling revenue mislabeled 'audited' when both IR sources are explicitly unaudited, and Magnific labeled 'bootstrapped' despite the research flagging EQT PE ownership. Found 12 unverifiable conflicts, led by three internal contradictions (Icon alive-in-§14 vs dead-in-moat-matrix; leaderboard half-life 'weeks' vs 'quarters' stated seven times two ways; UMG-v.-Suno live vs converted-to-license in §01) and several research-flagged conflicts stated as flat fact (Wan open-weights stopping at 2.2, Kling $18B spin-out vs a Bloomberg URL slug saying $2B, Runway's unsourced '~$90M mid-2025' that looks like a Kling figure cross-contamination, Sora's $1M/day picked from a $1M–15M range).
